title: Grid Trading - 0% AI - 100% old school - soon on alphasflowseven.com
author: engineering-AF7
selftext:
Works really well in ranging markets.

https://preview.redd.it/vy9wrp8rhsjh1.png?width=934&format=png&auto=webp&s=ea81c9250d0ec72a6e111a760bae4ac989c419f8

comments.author: mojovski
comments.body: you can't imagine how much money i burned with grid methods in the last 7 years....

replies.author: engineering-AF7
replies.body: Why was that? Of course if you are dealing with an instrument that is swapping a lot between trending than ranging I could see it happen. I set emergency stops and only trade in ranging markets. Usually I will hit a lot of winners and then if the instrument starts trending I can have to give some back when the emergency stops trigger.

comments.author: mojovski
comments.body: It's hard to find a stop loss that is smaller than the gains or is not wiping out 3 months of gains. Imho.
